summary: Accuray Inc filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with existing investors for the issuance of 55,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share for $55 million aggregate. Consideration consists of $15 million cash and cancellation of $40 million in existing indebtedness. The issuance is subject to stockholder approval and a reverse stock split. Outstanding warrants to purchase ~27.6 million shares will be cancelled upon closing. This is a distressed debt-for-equity recapitalization and warrant cancellation, not a standard M&A or activist event. Watch stockholder vote and reverse split implementation.
